sub_graphs.title: Capella: Validator Block Proposal with Withdrawals
sub_graphs.description: Models how validators construct and propose blocks that include withdrawal data in the execution payload

nodes.label: Validator Selected as Block Proposer
nodes.description: Validator has been selected as the proposer for the current slot

nodes.label: Gather Expected Withdrawals from State
nodes.description: Call get_expected_withdrawals on current beacon state to determine withdrawals for this slot

nodes.label: Prepare Execution Payload with Withdrawals
nodes.description: Construct PayloadAttributes including withdrawals field and send to execution engine via engine API

nodes.label: Execution Payload Ready
nodes.description: Execution engine has produced a payload including the specified withdrawals

nodes.label: Assemble Beacon Block
nodes.description: Combine beacon block body with execution payload, BLS-to-execution changes, and other operations

nodes.label: Block Proposed to Network
nodes.description: Signed beacon block broadcast to the P2P network

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: Execution layer client that produces execution payloads including withdrawal processing

sub_graphs.title: Capella: Validator BLS Credential Change Submission
sub_graphs.description: Models the validator-side process of submitting BLS-to-execution credential changes

nodes.label: Validator Has BLS Withdrawal Credentials
nodes.description: Validator currently uses BLS_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX (0x00) and cannot receive automatic withdrawals

nodes.label: Construct BLSToExecutionChange Message
nodes.description: Create message with validator_index, from_bls_pubkey (withdrawal key), and to_execution_address

nodes.label: Sign with BLS Withdrawal Secret Key
nodes.description: Sign the change message using the withdrawal BLS secret key (distinct from the validator signing key)

nodes.label: Signed BLS Change Ready for Submission
nodes.description: SignedBLSToExecutionChange message constructed and signed, ready to submit

nodes.label: Submit to Beacon Network
nodes.description: Broadcast signed credential change to beacon node for inclusion in a block

nodes.label: Credential Change Pending Inclusion
nodes.description: Change message in the network pool, awaiting block proposer to include it (max 16 per block)

external_entities.name: Validator Operator
external_entities.description: Human or automated system controlling the validator and possessing the BLS withdrawal key

sub_graphs.title: Capella: Validator Withdrawal Economics
sub_graphs.description: Models the economic aspects of validator withdrawals including partial and full withdrawal conditions

nodes.label: Active Validator with Excess Balance
nodes.description: Active validator has balance exceeding MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE with eth1 credentials

nodes.label: Exited Validator with Remaining Balance
nodes.description: Validator has exited, reached withdrawable epoch, and still has balance > 0

nodes.label: Compute Partial Withdrawal Amount
nodes.description: Calculate excess: balance - MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE for partial withdrawal

nodes.label: Compute Full Withdrawal Amount
nodes.description: Full balance of exited validator designated for withdrawal

nodes.label: Withdrawal Queued for Execution
nodes.description: Withdrawal amount determined and queued for inclusion in next available execution payload

ambiguities.text: The specification states credential changes are 'irreversible once on-chain' but does not explicitly define the behavior if a duplicate BLSToExecutionChange with a different target address is submitted.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the first valid credential change is applied and subsequent changes for the same validator are rejected because the credential prefix would no longer be 0x00.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine is trusted to honor the withdrawals specified in PayloadAttributes and include them in the produced execution payload.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious execution engine could omit or alter withdrawals, causing consensus-execution layer disagreement.

implicit_assumptions.description: Validator operators are assumed to securely store their BLS withdrawal keys separately from signing keys.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromise of signing keys would also compromise withdrawal credential changes, allowing fund redirection.
